text: The birria tacos here are incredible, super rich broth and the meat just falls apart. Their horchata is way too sweet for my taste though.
Came back just for the birria tacos again, still amazing. The elote was a little dry this time but still good.
Guacamole was bland and clearly made ahead of time. Chips were fresh at least.
Their kung pao chicken has the perfect amount of heat and the peanuts stay crunchy. Best in the city.
The dumplings were soggy and the dipping sauce tasted watered down. Kung pao chicken saved the meal though, still great.
